description: This is the main Dart source file for a Flutter application that initializes and integrates with Supabase, providing a simple UI to display todos retrieved from a 'todos' table in the Supabase database. It contains application entry point, app widget, error handling, and a page to list todos.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget for the app, manages different UI states including loading, error, and main content displaying todos.

classes.name: _InitErrorScreen
classes.description: Widget to display initialization error details and troubleshooting instructions.

classes.name: TodosPage
classes.description: Stateful widget that fetches and displays a list of todo items from the Supabase database.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; initializes Flutter widgets and Supabase, then runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp and _InitErrorScreen widgets, rendering the respective UI.

methods.name: _fetchTodos
methods.description: Fetches todo items from the 'todos' table in Supabase, ordered by 'id'.
